comparison.objective: Align and release an occluded passive service slider at a visual index; candidate commissions a shock absorber through mechanical adjustment and repeated impact trials.
comparison.physical_skill: Shared fine positioning, but slider manipulation does not require hex-key engagement, setscrew locking, collar adjustment, or response-based tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Slider requires sub-0.625 mm static alignment and release; candidate requires two safe ≥0.85 J cycles, ≤12 mm stroke, no hard-stop strike/rebound/overload, and bounded collar drift.
comparison.reason: Static hidden alignment tests a meaningfully different ability from locked, iterative dynamic-damping commissioning. The slider record has no spec version, but its body supplies clear outcome details.
